best_section.where: south kerb opposite the oval/park, between Melrose Ct area and the next run of houses, roughly two-thirds along the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Kerb backs onto a tree-screened park/oval; nearest houses are across the road, 10-17m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Straight, wide residential kerb with no driveways on the park side; easy pull-in for a light van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, not a through route; low likelihood of night traffic.
drivers.convention: Other cars already park along this kerb (visible in imagery), so a van won't stand out.

flags: Steep-ish: about 3.6% grade along the best section
2P parallel parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted, so unrestricted overnight
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy from the park overhangs the kerb from the south side, likely shading most of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether on-site signage differs from the extracted sign list
reasons: Backs onto screened park, not houses
summary: Tree-screened kerb beside a park, houses across the road, mild slope.
